Hero.summary: Since 2024 I have covered premieres, events and press conferences for Grupo Cadena Media, interviewing artists and public figures. I also direct short films and shoot concert, street and portrait photography.

Work.pageText: Reporting first, then film, video and photography.
Work.reportingText: Interview, walk-and-talk, how-to and product test, shot vertically. Best with sound.
Work.audiovisualText: I directed both short films and edited Tras el sofá. On the Silver Praxis music video, I did the filming and post-production.
Work.photographyText: Complete series, and an archive of 74 photographs to browse at your own pace.

Profile.bio: I'm a journalist and TV reporter, working at Grupo Cadena Media since 2024.
Profile.bioMore: I cover premieres, events and press conferences, interview artists and public figures, and write scripts and news pieces. I studied Journalism and Audiovisual Communication at Universidad Rey Juan Carlos. Spanish and Russian are both my native languages.
